description: Reads what the Analytics place shows for one project: every number Marsell holds over the days asked (sales, visits, followers, views and the rest, each with where it came from; leavesOutTeam on Stripe's count of new customers, which leaves out the business's own team, while the money counts every payment and subscription, the team's own included; Stripe's revenue is before tax wherever Stripe gives the tax), which of them lead for this kind of project (leads: its goal's number first; a free tool leads with downloads and stars, never money), what nothing counts yet with the owner's next step, what people searched for, the site's pages as Google Search showed them, the business's reviews on Google, the posts that went out in the span with their pictures and reach, the business's own channel and code project with their numbers, and its own site's visits read now. Where people press on the site and Google Analytics' own count are not in it: they are on the Analytics place. Nothing is spent. One number day by day is metrics_series, what each piece of work brought outcomes_summary, what each ad brought ad_results_read.

days.description: The span, in days ending today. 30 when left out.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
